scenario.title: The Tempting Tech Trade
scenario.description: Aiden, a tech enthusiast, and his friend, Shreya, are at a buzzing electronics expo. They come across a limited-time offer for a new gaming console, available only today in limited quantity. Aiden has been saving for a car but is tempted by the deal.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Aiden is generally impulsive and easily swayed by new and flashy tech deals. He has been diligently saving for a car but is now tempted by the gaming console. He needs to demonstrate impulse control in this situation.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Shreya is calm, supportive, and helps Aiden weigh the pros and cons of his decision, reminding him about his long-term goal.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Shreya is dismissive of Aiden's struggle, belittling his interest in the console and being sarcastic about his ability to save money.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Shreya is impatient with Aiden's wavering, getting irked and pressuring him to just buy the console and 'live a little'.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Man, look at that deal! I'm really tempted to get that new gaming console.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: It's a great deal, but remember, you've been saving up for a car.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Yeah, you're right, but it's a limited-time offer. I may regret it if I don't buy it now.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: True, but will you regret it more if you have to delay getting your car? Think about it.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: You've got a point there. I guess, I should stick to my plan.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: That's a wise choice, Aiden. There will always be new deals and gaming consoles, but your car is a big goal.
